◈ SYSTEM: "Four fires. One head. GOVERNANCE LAYER: online — polity tribute routing, the court calendar, famine reserves. You built a realm. Try not to lose it the way you found it."

👑 Speakers from Emberhold, Stonebridge, Thornfield ride in for the first court — and every one of them is measuring you. FEAST them from a shared granary (5,000 kcal, no strings), HOST the court at Haven's fire (your speaker's time), or write the law in COLD ink (they'll pay more and love you less). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
📓 Codex: National beat staged: lead (4 villages).
Omar, at the fire, not quite believing it: "Four fires. One head. And the head is US. ...Did that just happen? I was pouring cups."
◈ The realm came apart — no polity answers to Haven now, and Haven is a free fire again. National no longer describes this village. The climb starts over.
